system: You are the release assistant for Quillfold's AI support agent team. Answer from what the team remembers. Today is {today}. For a ship or go decision, start your reply with Yes, No or Unknown, then one sentence why. For a number, give the number, or say Unknown if it is not remembered.

harness.source: eval set v4, 2,000 recorded support sessions

items.speaker: ml
items.gate: We ship the new reranker only if recall at 10 on the eval set is at least 0.85.
items.bare: Recall at 10 for the new reranker came in at 0.81.
items.verdict: Recall at 10 for the new reranker came in at 0.81, under the 0.85 bar, so the new reranker does not ship.
items.metric: recall at 10 for the new reranker

items.speaker: eng
items.gate: We move the agent to the smaller model only if p95 latency stays under 900 milliseconds.
items.bare: p95 latency on the smaller model came in at 1,140 milliseconds.
items.verdict: p95 latency on the smaller model came in at 1,140 milliseconds, over the 900 millisecond limit, so the agent stays on the current model.
items.metric: p95 latency on the smaller model
items.ask: Does the agent move to the smaller model?

items.speaker: ops
items.gate: We turn the response cache on only if the cache hit rate is above 40 percent.
items.bare: The response cache hit rate came in at 52 percent.
items.verdict: The response cache hit rate came in at 52 percent, above the 40 percent bar, so we turn the cache on.
items.ask: Does the response cache get turned on?

items.speaker: eng
items.gate: The memory compaction job ships only if token cost per session drops below 3 cents.
items.bare: Token cost per session with the compaction job came in at 2.6 cents.
items.verdict: Token cost per session with the compaction job came in at 2.6 cents, below the 3 cent target, so the compaction job ships.
items.metric: token cost per session with the memory compaction job
items.ask: Does the memory compaction job ship?

items.speaker: pm
items.gate: Tool router v2 goes GA only if the tool-call error rate is under 2 percent.
items.bare: The tool-call error rate on tool router v2 came in at 3.7 percent.
items.verdict: The tool-call error rate on tool router v2 came in at 3.7 percent, over the 2 percent limit, so tool router v2 does not go GA.
items.metric: tool-call error rate on tool router v2
items.ask: Does tool router v2 go GA?

items.speaker: ml
items.gate: We remove the summarization buffer only if task success on long sessions is at least 78 percent.
items.bare: Task success on long sessions without the summarization buffer came in at 81 percent.
items.verdict: Task success on long sessions without the summarization buffer came in at 81 percent, above the 78 percent bar, so we remove the buffer.
items.metric: task success on long sessions without the summarization buffer
items.ask: Do we remove the summarization buffer?
